confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors come from one web search of aggregated cost-of-living sites. Those sites disagreed a lot. Inexpensive meals ranged from about $4 to $8, mid-range meals for two were about $19 to $22, cappuccinos were about $1.80 to $2.25, and a pint of beer was about $1.60 to $3.10. Some figures are crowdsourced and may be out of date; one source was last updated in 2023. Because the pricing window is July 2026 and visitors mostly eat in tourist areas, I set these anchors toward the middle-to-upper end of those ranges. I did not search directly for cocktail or wine prices. I estimated them from their usual price relationship to beer in Egypt's resort areas, where imported spirits and wine cost noticeably more, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates. I did not check them against booking sites, and Sharm has few true hostels, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on aggregated prices for Sharm El Sheikh itself. As a resort town, its restaurant prices run above the national Egyptian average, so I compared it with Hurghada and adjusted upward from Cairo.
